title: fix(hostmatcher): block reserved IP ranges from external/private filters

target.summary: MatchBuiltinPrivate checks isPrivateIP, which matches reserved special-purpose ranges such as Azure WireServer (168.63.129.16) and IPv6 transition tunnels alongside standard private networks. If MatchBuiltinPrivate is used in an allow-list, requests to sensitive cloud metadata and reserved internal endpoints are permitted, re-introducing SSRF vulnerabilities.
notes: faulty check where MatchBuiltinPrivate matches reserved special-purpose IPs via isPrivateIP
definition of isPrivateIP helper which incorrectly classifies reserved special-purpose IP ranges as private
